title: Execute dynamic HDR metadata extraction plan
summary: Adds an inert Dynamic HDR metadata extraction executor that consumes the existing command plan, runs planned commands through the shared native runner, records per-command results, validates non-empty HEVC/RPU/HDR10+ artifacts, persists RPU summary evidence, and parses RPU frame counts.
reason: Dynamic HDR encode preservation needs a tested fail-closed extraction execution layer before Do-Encode policy routing and x265 injection can safely call it.
behavior_before: Dynamic HDR extraction had a pure command planner, but no helper executed the planned commands, checked output artifacts, captured command results, or parsed RPU frame-count evidence.
behavior_after: Export-DynamicHdrMetadata executes a successful extraction plan without changing pipeline routing. It stops on the first failed command, timeout/stop/abort, missing non-empty artifact, missing RPU summary, or missing positive frame count, and returns registered Dynamic HDR extraction outcome codes for future policy fallback.
tests_added: Extended ops/pipeline/tests/Unit/Invoke-DynamicHdrToolingChecks.ps1 with fake-native-runner coverage for extraction execution order, command result capture, artifact checks, RPU frame-count parsing, command failure, and empty HDR10+ artifact failure.
Registered Dynamic HDR extraction outcome codes so Invoke-FailureCodeRegistryChecks.ps1 covers future emissions.
rollback_plan: Revert this packet plus Export-DynamicHdrMetadata, helper functions, tooling-test executor cases, Dynamic HDR extraction outcome-code registration, docs, and generated summaries. The previous command planner remains a separate committed slice.
notes:
Add inert Dynamic HDR metadata extraction executor over planned commands.
Cover extraction execution order, artifact checks, frame-count parsing, and fail-closed failures.
Reflect extraction executor progress while keeping encode wiring and validation open.
Update active gap summary for extraction executor progress.
Record execution helper status and remaining Dynamic HDR work.
Refresh summary after active-state documentation update.
Refresh Dynamic HDR process summary after extraction executor addition.
Refresh Dynamic HDR tooling test summary after executor coverage additions.
Register Dynamic HDR extraction outcome codes and encode-surface metadata.
Refresh failure-code summary after Dynamic HDR outcome-code registration.
High-risk boundary note: this slice executes only when future code explicitly calls Export-DynamicHdrMetadata. It is not wired into Do-Encode, does not alter route selection, does not publish or drain, and does not mutate source/output media. Encode injection wiring, policy fallback, output verification, and representative real-media validation remain open.
